summary: A repository holding several deployables or packages. This document is the map; each part gets its own document with its own type.

repo-map.must: Every package/app/service in the repo: type (service, monolith, library, frontend, infra), folder, responsibility, owner, and the link to its own document (or 'pending' plus an open question when it has none yet).

dependency-graph.must: Diagram of which parts depend on which (package references, API calls, shared databases, shared libraries), plus the rules: what may depend on what.

tooling.must: Workspace manager (npm/pnpm/yarn workspaces, Nx, Turborepo, Lerna, Bazel, .NET solution filters, Gradle multi-project), task orchestration, caching, how affected-only builds/tests work, shared configs.

conventions.must: Folder and naming conventions, how to add a new part, code style and linting, commit and branch conventions, versioning and release strategy (fixed vs independent).

problem.must: What the repo groups together and why, and what deliberately lives elsewhere.

configuration.must: Configuration shared by all parts (root env files, shared config packages, CI variables) and where each part's own configuration is documented.
